description.value: Bacchus is a Michelin-Recommended restaurant and lounge tucked inside the Wedgewood Hotel & Spa, a Relais & Châteaux property in downtown Vancouver, featuring ornate Venetian decor and original artwork. The award-winning kitchen blends European-inspired technique with regional ingredients and sustainably sourced seafood, supported by an extensive wine program overseen by an on-site sommelier. The hotel also lists a 'Wedgewood Bicycles' guest service in its concierge offerings, hinting at some bicycle awareness on the property.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the restaurant at 845 Hornby Street inside the Wedgewood Hotel & Spa, corroborating OSM address and phone. OSM tags diet:vegetarian=yes and diet:vegan=no provide the primary evidence for the vegetarian/vegan amenity, and the website does not contradict these. No bike parking, water refill, takeout, or Wi-Fi is mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags; the hotel navigation lists 'Wedgewood Bicycles' as a concierge service but the transport subpage was truncated and no specific bike parking details for the restaurant were captured.
concerns: OSM name is 'Bacchus' but the full business name per the website is 'Bacchus Restaurant & Lounge' — possible truncation in OSM.
The hotel navigation lists 'Wedgewood Bicycles' under Concierge & Services but the transport subpage was truncated; bike parking availability for restaurant guests could not be confirmed.
High-end fine-dining positioning (Relais & Châteaux, Michelin-Recommended) may make this a low-priority WWC listing for most touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Bacchus is a confirmed operating fine-dining restaurant, but the required bike parking/visibility criterion is unconfirmed and its upscale Michelin-Recommended format may not serve the typical touring cyclist; manual review should confirm whether hotel bicycle facilities are accessible to restaurant guests.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Wedgewood Hotel's 'Wedgewood Bicycles' concierge service (visible in site navigation) may indicate on-site bike storage or rental; a direct inquiry or review of the transport/concierge page could confirm bike parking eligibility for restaurant guests.
